scalar_hessian_188_verification.ew_vacuum_scope_note: Hessian verified at the unbroken EW origin (<Phi>=0); tuning lambda_1 = -mu_SM^2 gives the expected tachyonic EWSB curvature, and full EW-broken vacuum stability with <h> != 0 and quartic backreaction remains open.

tree_level_higgs_stability_audit.obstruction_summary: FAILED / OPEN at tree level for the matched negative-portal BM-LR point: lambda_hDelta < 0 puts r = -lambda_hDelta x / (2 lambda_eff) > 0 in the physical quadrant where V_4(x, r) = lambda_H^SM(v_R) x^2 < 0 (unbounded below). Stabilizing requires lambda_H^SM(v_R) > 0 (as at BM-LOW/BM-GUT), positive-portal lambda_hDelta > 0 copositivity, or radiative effective-potential / UV RG stabilization.
